0: Wrinkle [built-in] - Fine, sharp creases for skin folds and fabric wrinkles.
1: Palette Knife [built-in] - Flattens and drags clay sideways like a sculptor's knife.
2: Dragon Scales [built-in] - Stamps rounded overlapping scales along the stroke.
3: Stone Carve [built-in] - Scrapes hard planes and breaks them up with cracks for rocks and ruins.
4: Skin Pores [built-in] - Sprinkles tiny pores for close-up skin detail.
5: Clay Slab [built-in] - Builds up flat-topped strokes of clay for blocking in forms.
6: Edge Wear [built-in] - Chips and softens only the sharp edges and ridges, for weathered props.
7: Block Former [built-in, Clay & Form] - Big, flat-topped clay strokes that stack fast, for blocking in primary forms.
8: Soft Clay [built-in, Clay & Form] - Gentle round clay that builds in thin layers and blends into the surface.
9: Clay Strip [built-in, Clay & Form] - Narrow, crisp strips of clay with a hard edge, for muscle fibres and planes.
10: Plane Cutter [built-in, Clay & Form] - Shaves the surface down to flat planes, for stylised forms and stone.
11: Volume Fill [built-in, Clay & Form] - Fills low areas up to the stroke's plane and leaves the high points alone.
12: Level Out [built-in, Clay & Form] - Presses hills and valleys onto one plane and softens the result, to calm busy areas.
13: Swell [built-in, Clay & Form] - Puffs the surface out along its own normals, for cheeks, bellies and soft volumes.
14: Form Smoother [built-in, Clay & Form] - Relaxes lumps while keeping the big shape, for a clean pass after blocking.
15: Clay Drag [built-in, Clay & Form] - Smears soft clay along the stroke like a thumb pushing it, for blending transitions.
16: Edge Definer [built-in, Clay & Form] - Pinches a crisp edge into the surface where two planes meet.
17: Panel Groove [built-in, Hard Surface] - Cuts a clean, narrow groove for panel gaps and seams.
18: Flat Plane [built-in, Hard Surface] - Presses a perfectly flat face with a hard edge, for machined surfaces.
